periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation, angled approximately 45 degrees downward toward the snout relative to the horizontal facial plane.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertical oval profile, with a height significantly exceeding the width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering that terminates in a distinct point well below the orbital center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: A shallow, relatively flat U-shape across the posterior margin of the shoulder band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The band occupies roughly 25-30% of the visible torso length along the lateral flank.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: A wide gap of white fur between the ears, roughly twice the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly smooth, semi-circular convex arcs at the top of both visible ear regions.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant yellowish-brown discoloration across the majority of the dorsal and lateral white fur of the torso.
